description: This file defines the Content class for managing note content within the Notesnook project, including methods for adding, retrieving, updating, deleting, and processing content, as well as handling internal links and attachments.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: A class implementing the ICollection interface for managing content items in the database, including CRUD operations, media handling, and content processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SQL collection for content.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a content item, handling encryption, post-processing, and history logging.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a content item by ID, performing pre-processing if necessary.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Soft deletes content items by IDs.

methods.name: removeByNoteId
methods.description: Marks content items associated with specific note IDs as deleted.

methods.name: updateByNoteId
methods.description: Updates content items associated with specific note IDs.

methods.name: findByNoteId
methods.description: Finds a content item by note ID, with pre-processing.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a content item exists by ID.

methods.name: downloadMedia
methods.description: Downloads media attachments for a content item.

methods.name: removeAttachments
methods.description: Removes specified attachments from a content item.

methods.name: preProcess
methods.description: Performs pre-processing on content, such as migration and inserting block IDs.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Performs post-processing on content, including handling internal links and attachments.

methods.name: processLinkedAttachments
methods.description: Links or unlinks attachments related to a note based on hashes.

methods.name: processInternalLinks
methods.description: Manages internal note links, adding or removing links as needed.
